project_title: BarberStudio CRM & Client Self-Service Booking System
theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & VINTAGE INDUSTRIAL (Noir Leather & Burnished Amber)

design_language.vibe: High-end bespoke barbershop, dark obsidian surfaces, warm amber-gold brass accents, crisp contrast, refined typography, smooth transitions
design_language.theme_mode: Dark-first luxury theme (default dark mode with togglable refined light mode)
design_language.primary_font: Outfit, sans-serif (Headings and high-impact UI elements)
design_language.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Body text, data tables, form inputs)
design_language.accent_font: Cinzel / Cormorant Garamond (Subtle luxury badges & overlines)

headings.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-amber-50 leading-tight
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-100

public_booking_tab.description: Client self-service booking step-by-step flow (1. Select Barber -> 2. Select Service -> 3. Select Date & Slot -> 4. Confirm Details). Real-time slot locking.
public_booking_tab.visual_style: Hero-style booking card with barber avatars, active availability status indicator, interactive time slot chips that grey out once occupied.

appointments_calendar_tab.description: Admin/Staff master schedule view. Filterable by barber, date picker, status chips (Confirmed, Completed, In-Progress, Cancelled, No-Show). Actionable buttons to add appointment, edit slot, or mark done.
appointments_calendar_tab.visual_style: Interactive grid/timeline view with color-coded appointment cards per barber.

barbers_management_tab.description: Staff roster & working hours manager. Each barber has profile details, specialty tags, commission rate, custom weekly shift schedule (e.g., Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00), break times, and performance metrics.
barbers_management_tab.visual_style: Barber cards with toggleable working hours modal, photo upload preview, and total cuts counter.

clients_crm_tab.description: Customer list with haircut history, preferred barber, total spend, loyalty points, visit frequency notes, and quick action buttons (Book New, Call, Edit Profile).
clients_crm_tab.visual_style: High density data table with avatar icons, loyalty tier badges (Bronze, Silver, Gold, VIP Black), search bar, filter by plan status.

loyalty_clients_tab.description: Dedicated 'Clientes Fidelizados' VIP rewards tracking. Point balance, reward redemption history, automated discount codes, and VIP Tier upgrades.
loyalty_clients_tab.visual_style: Gamified loyalty cards, progress bars towards next free haircut, and reward claim buttons.

plans_subscriptions_tab.description: Monthly Barber Subscription Plans ('Planos de Assinatura' e.g. Basic Fade - 2 cuts/mo, Executive VIP - Unlimited cuts + Beard, Club Premium). Active subscribers list & renewal tracking.
plans_subscriptions_tab.visual_style: Pricing tier cards with glowing border beam effect on recommended plan, active subscriber metrics widget.

dashboard_stats_tab.description: Executive summary with total revenue today/month, total appointments completed, top revenue barber, active subscribers count, quick actions bar.
dashboard_stats_tab.visual_style: Bento metric widgets with mini sparkline charts (Recharts / Lucide icons).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Implementation stack utilizes JavaScript React (.js files in /app/frontend/src/ components). Ensure prop types and JS syntax are strictly clean.
2. Ensure data-testid attribute is placed on EVERY button, select, tab, modal, table row, input, and time slot card for reliable testing.
3. Implement local state fallback and mock backend endpoints so the CRM operates smoothly out of the box with seed data for Barbers, Clients, Appointments, Subscriptions, and Loyalty Points.

4. When a user books an appointment for a specific barber and time slot (e.g. Barber Marcos at 14:00 on May 15), that time slot MUST dynamically change status to 'Occupied/Indisponível' and prevent duplicate bookings.

5. Provide quick tabs in the main CRM header/sidebar: 'Agendamentos (Calendar)', 'Barbeiros (Team)', 'Clientes (CRM)', 'Clientes Fidelizados (Loyalty)', 'Planos de Assinatura (Subscriptions)', 'Visão Geral (Dashboard)', and 'Agendar Horário (Public Booking Area)'.

6. Include quick Portuguese language options / terms suited for Brazilian/Portuguese barbershop culture ('Corte de Cabelo', 'Barba Completa', 'Combo Corte + Barba', 'Sobrancelha', 'Plano Vip Mensal', 'Pontos de Fidelidade').
7. Ensure dark luxury look with warm gold/amber accents, non-transparent popups/dropdowns, and responsive mobile-first layouts.
